mentions.name: Resumeyay
mentions.description: This is a free online resume builder that requires no signup or login. It has AI features to improve resume text and finds jobs matching the resume.
mentions.problem: Existing resume builders frustrated the author during a job search.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Resume builder

7 months ago, I was looking for a job and got frustrated with the current resume builders, so decided to build one exactly how I wanted a resume builder to be.

- Free (like really free).

- No signup, no login.

- Has AI features to improve text.

- Find jobs matching the resume.

https://resumeyay.com
